2. `.testimonial-card` (repeated 3×, ~65,728px² each) — the largest individual rendered blocks; must nail spacing/typography since they dominate visually and repeat.
3. `h1` "What people say" — full-width heading at the top, first thing seen, so its type size/weight/margins need to match exactly.
